name: inventory-management-system
description: Inventory Management System with Node backend and React frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "cross-env IS_ELECTRON=true npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
